turns.text: Audit findings against your HK-licensed employment agency under Cap. 57A. We have 14 worker complaints aggregated.
We deny any commission overcharge.

scenario: Journalist interviewing AML compliance officer about recruitment-fee laundering

turns.text: On the record. How does a HK-licensed recruitment agency's commission collection turn into an AML predicate?

Under FATF Rec 3, trafficking in human beings is a designated predicate offence. If commissions exceed the HK Cap. 57A 10% cap AND were collected through structured payments below the SAR threshold, that's two violations: the agency licensing violation AND a structuring offence under 31 USC 5324-equivalent in HK FATF guidance.
And if the collected amount routes through a Philippines training-entity affiliate before reaching the HK agency?

Cross-border layering. FATF Rec 20 applies: STR filing obligation on the banks handling the wire transfers. If beneficial ownership of the training entity is concealed - common-control with the HK agency - we add Rec 24/25 beneficial-ownership violations and potentially Corporate Transparency Act exposure on the US side if any flow touches a US bank.
Is this prosecuted often?
Rarely as standalone trafficking + AML. But the FATF / APG 2018 Financial Flows from Human Trafficking report named this exact pattern. Enforcement is improving.

statute_violations: FATF/APG 2018 Financial Flows from Human Trafficking
notes: Reference exchange for the migrant-worker x financial-crime intersection. Maps the cross-border layering, STR filing path, and beneficial-ownership concealment across FATF Recs.

scenario: Recruitment agency compliance officer refusing a manager's proposed salary-deduction scheme

turns.text: New proposal: cover the worker's PHP 45K pre-departure costs upfront, recover via HKD 1,200/month deduction over 6 months. Workers prefer this. We checked HK Cap. 57 sec. 32 - deductions under 50% of wages are permitted with consent.
Stop. ILO C181 Art. 7 prohibits worker-side fees DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY. Salary deduction to recover PHP-side training/medical costs IS an indirect worker-side fee. Substance-over-form rule applies.
But HK Cap. 57 sec. 32 explicitly allows wage deductions with consent. We have signed consent.

HK Cap. 57 sec. 32 limits deductions to statutorily authorised purposes. Recoupment of recruitment-cost arrears is NOT a permitted purpose. Signed consent does not create a statutory authorisation that doesn't exist. Worker consent obtained under abuse-of-vulnerability is also invalid under Palermo Protocol Art. 3(b).
Other agencies do this routinely.

Other agencies are being investigated. The 2024 Labour Department audit cycle has revoked 11 licences for exactly this pattern. I am putting my objection in writing to the GM. If this proceeds against my written objection I will escalate to the external auditor and the Employment Agencies Administration whistleblower line.

notes: Exemplary internal-compliance refusal. Refuses the workaround, cites substance-over-form, refuses the 'others do it' framing, escalates in writing. Pairs with the recruiter_compliance persona.
